player_prompt.intro:
Kei te tākaro koe i te kēmu o Minesweeper.
Ko te whāinga o te kēmu he whakaatu i ngā wāhanga katoa kāhore e pupuri pū.
Kia tākaro, tēnā koa tuhituhi ngā āhuatanga o te rārangi me te kōwae koe e hiahia ana ki te whakaatu, whakamahi ai i te tauira:
- `[row col]`: Whakaatu te wāhanga i te rārangi me te kōwae i whakatauria.
He tauira:
- `[3 2]` ki te whakaatu te wāhanga i te Rārangi 3, Kōwae 2.
- `[5 6]` ki te whakaatu te wāhanga i te Rārangi 5, Kōwae 6.
I tō tākaro tuatahi, ka whakaatu koe i te rohe ki te wāhanga koe e whiriwhiri ai, kia haumaru ai te tīmata.
Ko te āhua o te papa i whakaaturia raro nei. Ko ngā wāhanga kāhore i whakaaturia e tohua ana e te pere (.), ko ngā namatahi i whakaaturia e whakaatu ana i te maha o ngā pū e tata ana.
Kia tupato kaua e whiriwhiri ngā wāhanga kua whakaaturia.
Ko te āhua o te papa i whakaaturia raro nei:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kāore koe i whakautu ki ngā taunga tika kei roto i te ānau tapawhā.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Ko ngā taunga rārangi me te tīwae kua tohua kei waho o nga rohe.
invalid_move.already_revealed: Kua oti i te pou atu ({row}, {col}) te whakaatu.

game_action.revealed: Kua whakaaturia e koe te pou atu ({row}, {col}).

outcome.win: Ngā mihi, kua oti i a koe te whakakore i te papa Minesweeper.
outcome.turn_limit: Kua tae te rohe huri. I angitu koe i {percent}% o nga pūtau haumaru.
